verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents SharePoint REST and Graph file CRUD, driveItem read-write access, batching and webhooks. Nothing describes a thumbnail or embeddable preview endpoint that renders common formats server-side. Generic file and driveItem access is adjacent and does not show that previews are served as an API call, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As a developer, previews are an API call — thumbnails and embeddable document previews served for common formats without me rendering them
